IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: Border Angels promotes a culture of love through advocacy education by creating a social consciousness and engaging in direct action to defend the rights of migrants and refugees.
IRS990.MissionDesc: We advocate for human rights humane immigration reform and social justice. Our efforts aim to reduce fatalities along the US-Mexico border by educating and assisting communities on both sides. Our services include educational programs Water Drops in the desert Day Laborer Outreach the Familias Reunidas Immigration Bond Fund program and Shelter Aid support in Tijuana for migrants and asylum seekers in need.
IRS990.Desc: The Shelter Aid program supports the migrant shelters in Tijuana that we partner with. Through this program we provide funding to our trusted shelter directors to cover expenses such as rent utilities construction and groceries. Currently we support 11 shelters in Tijuana that host asylum seekers refugees and deportees.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: Our Water Drop program has volunteers who trek into the desert to place water and supplies along migrant paths aiming to prevent further deaths at the US-Mexico border.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: We visit sites where day laborers congregate providing them with food water clothing Know Your Rights cards and hygiene products. Our programs goal is to offer moral and emotional support and document their stories. We also provide resources on employee rights and safety work tools to help them work safely.
